descriptionText:
Aquaman #17 (June 2004, DC Comics) -- "Urban Renewal," Will Pfeifer and Patrick Gleason, from the Sub Diego era. Direct sales edition. Back cover carries the Tracy McGrady "got milk?" ad. Cover price $2.50 US.

Condition: Very Good. Cover clean and glossy with light handling wear. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
